**Plan: parse `--json` in `cli.js`, print `buildRows()` output, leave the table path alone.**

1. In [cli.js:9](src/cli.js:9), accept `report --json` in any arg order.
2. On the flag, write `JSON.stringify(buildRows(), null, 2)`.
3. Update `USAGE` to `usage: cli.js report [--json]`.
4. Reject unknown flags with the same exit code 1.

One call to make. The table drops `owner` and `slow` on purpose, per [format.js:3](src/format.js:3). JSON has no width limit, so I would print all six fields from `buildRows()`. That means `--json` shows more than the table, not the same columns. Say the word if you want it capped to the four.
